ACTIVATION_EVALUATION_RULE.PRE_NATIVE_ACTIONS: Only expressly scoped metadata/process confinement preflight, synthetic preparation and fake backend qualification; no native fixture execution while EP70-PHASE is false.
ACTIVATION_EVALUATION_RULE.RULE: For the requested phase, enable only if every listed independently evidenced predicate has exact boolean true and its evidence pins/current identities match. Missing/false/unknown/not-applicable-as-bypass/string-true denies. Controller authentication of issued grant is external; an input assertion of a grant never qualifies.

BOUNDARY_COMPLETENESS: No unknown permission is accepted; future values governed by exact closed selectors and denial rules, not claimed known now

DEPENDENCY_VERSIONS.NEW_SOURCES_AND_COMPLETE_STDLIB_LOADER_C: UNDETERMINED until bounded construction and independent sealing; EP70-CODE-SEAL denies test launch until exact manifest matches

ENVIRONMENT_FRESHNESS_RULE: All eleven predicates independently rerun at each phase/entry; any drift stops. A changed observed host/runtime or broadened boundary requires a newly qualified subject and owner decision, not silent rebind.
FILESYSTEM_PERMISSIONS: Current stat/access observations only; independently verified scoped rights and mounts required at entry

INPUT_OUTPUT_PATH_SELECTION.EVIDENCE_PUBLICATION: Controller only, exclusive immutable publication; no preexisting target overwrite or deletion; exact generated file paths/hashes in manifest
INPUT_OUTPUT_PATH_SELECTION.SCRATCH_BASENAME_RULE: kge-a15-harness-test- followed by one lowercase 32-hex campaign token; mkdir exclusive mode0700 by approved actor; actual path and inode sealed before use; no symlink ancestors or reuse

NETWORK_POLICY: DENY external network; exact enforced private namespace and verified no external route/interface, no external socket or service access

PREDICATES.EXACT_RULE: Authenticate future issued implementation/test grant against exact Package70 subject digest, effective charter/lifecycle, project-owner approval/direct role and normative reference. Deny missing/revoked/superseded/expired/wrong-scope grants. Grant evidence is outside editable sources and immutable test outputs; no test or module can self-authorize.

Current actor UID/GID, host facts/content identity, interpreter and bwrap hashes equal approved observation. Independently establish actual actor resource control and operation permissions, including every source parent write/search and each input read/search; deny any mismatch/unknown. Never derive OS rights from charter or rely on inherited elevated privilege.

All paths resolve under exact six-source allowlist, private campaign scratch or evidence root. lstat every ancestor, reject symlinks/foreign ownership and preexisting creation/publication targets; sources only new six files. Preserve preexisting evidence/runtime/E1 hashes. Root workspace write access alone is insufficient.

Trusted independent controller seals exact six new source bytes and unchanged native dependency pins, interpreter/loader/stdlib executable dependency closure, approved invocation/argv/cwd/clean environment and fixture/oracle manifest. Future source hashes are generated artifacts under bounded creation authority; missing/drifting closure denies tests. No package install/network dependency or modification of native modules.

Independent launcher confines inputs to readonly exact pinned code/runtime libraries, only the new test module, immutable synthetic fixtures/oracles and copied native policy. Real checkpoint, 19 ledgers, Package59 real inputs, real oracles and runtime output path are not mounted/readable by the native test child. Scratch output row is the only writable fixture resource. Network namespace isolated with no external interfaces/routes, inherited descriptors closed, environment allowlisted, no host privilege escalation. Verify actual namespace/mount/access properties from a trusted bounded metadata preflight after approval; unknown mechanism/usability denies native testing.

Independently verify lowering child hard/soft RLIMIT_CPU, AS, FSIZE and NOFILE to approved caps; supervisor enforce max live/total children, per-child/overall monotonic deadlines and total bytes. Abort on unsupported setting/overflow. Only owned campaign child groups may be terminated/reaped on timeout; no system process/cgroup broad rights inferred. Resource policy values are proposed caps, not claims of current enforceability.

First qualify input/authority/path gates and supervisor isolation/exit/reader ordering using injected fake backend and bounded metadata-only child processes. Independent controller verifies exact qualified source identities and protocol evidence. Native integration remains disabled until those checks and actual confinement/permission predicates pass; phase success is a prerequisite under an already issued grant, never a new grant.

Authenticate immutable synthetic fixture and preexecution independently qualified full expected output seals; full native identities, reserved scope/lineage/generation/names and distinctness against explicit real denylist. Validate all synthetic source and copied policy pins. All native bundle/descriptor/path arguments must be exactly fixture manifest entries; expected values cannot come from execution. Deny real Snapshot/bundle/source/event/variant identities or real checkpoint/archive data as execution input.

Before worker launch, verify independent process/start/output identity and trusted supervisor method/clean environment. Observe own-child successful wait after that worker actually exits, then verify exact publication and handoff; readers launch only when all three READER_LAUNCH_REQUIRED_RUNTIME_FACTS hold. During fake-protocol qualification, these outcomes are measured rather than assumed. During native phase, the method must already be independently protocol-qualified, and every actual runtime fact is still freshly observed. No worker self-exit claim, warm object or cross-variant reuse.

Only allowlisted native read/query/record/save/restore calls on exact synthetic objects. record_result owns synthetic SourceInvalidation application, no separate apply_event; no HEAD/commit_event, real A15 variant, source file mutation, production/E1/native-runtime change. Check operation count and effect class against sealed fixture contract; any unknown call denied.

Trusted independent controller records profile/grant/subject/code/fixture/oracle IDs, monotonic launch/wait/exit ordering and hashes, publication/handoff/reader comparisons, failed cases, budget/accounting and final preservation. Failure stops activation, retains evidence, no auto retry or optimistic PASS. Test child cannot supply its own authority/permission/exit certification. Seal successful executable/environment only after independent comparisons and preservation succeed.

PREDICATE_EVALUATOR_REQUIREMENTS: Trusted qualification controller/engineering launcher external to worker/module under test; authentic grant and OS/source evidence independent of editable test code and assertions. Exact evaluator/profile identity and enforcement results independently sealed before native tests. If unavailable, native integration stays blocked.
PROCESS_CREATION_PERMISSIONS: Observed metadata subprocess ability is not future test permission; must satisfy EP70-ACTOR/CONFINEMENT/LIMITS/GRANT for each launch

RESOURCE_LIMITS.EXTRA_CAMPAIGNS: Require fresh explicit bounded approval; no implicit repeat after failure/timeout/budget depletion

TEMPORAL_GATES.FINAL_SEAL: Independently verify all required future synthetic results, exact runtime comparisons, failed-case evidence/budget accounting and preservation; permission alone is not successful implementation qualification.
TEMPORAL_GATES.READER_LAUNCH_RULE: All three exact runtime facts independently verified by controller AND phase entry predicates still valid. Worker/handoff assertions alone do not satisfy any runtime fact.
TEMPORAL_GATES.WORKER_LAUNCH: Evaluate phase entry permissions, immutable input/profile/code and independent qualified supervision method before worker start; do not require that worker exit has already occurred.
